AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. joule (J)
   C. newton (N)
   D. pascal (Pa)

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

4. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.

6. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Heating until a solid melts

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

12. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

13. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.

15. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.

16. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Nitrogen gas only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Making Tacking Stitches and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
